regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 72". Sugar Bowl and Sierra-at-Tahoe follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Kirkwood Wednesday and Wednesday night. Winter Storm Warning at Kirkwood from Wednesday to Friday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 53". The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Wednesday and Wednesday night. The NWS is calling for more at Mammoth: 62 to 86 inches Wednesday through Sunday night. Winter Storm Warning at Mammoth from Wednesday to Friday.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbasin is forecast for about 44", 25" of it Friday. Powder Mountain and Brighton follow.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 26". Jackson Hole and Sun Valley follow.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 17". Taos follows.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride is forecast for about 10". Steamboat and Crested Butte follow.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Bachelor is forecast for about 11", 6" of it Wednesday. Crystal Mountain and Stevens Pass follow. The NWS is calling for more at Crystal Mountain: 3 to 10 inches Wednesday through Monday night.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Fernie is forecast for about 6". Whitewater and RED Mountain follow.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Cypress Mountain is forecast for about 6", 4" of it Sunday. Whistler follows. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Whistler Sunday night.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
